title: Understanding Parents’ Desires in Moderating Children’s Interactions with GenAI Chatbots through LLM-Generated Probes
reasoning: The paper investigates how parents want GenAI chatbots to handle moral and ethical instruction for their children. It evaluates parental concerns regarding 'Potentially Harmful Intention' and 'moral implications,' and examines the chatbot's role as a 'moral and developmental guide' in reinforcing family values and household norms.
